title: AusMT Station Metadata 0.1-draft: canonical public representation of one published station record
description: Draft (0.x): the promoted station.json - one published station record within a survey context, not a globally unique physical site. Two formal branches: the full record keeps an open schema (existing keys frozen and permitted; runs[] and resources[] are the new canonical model), while the withheld record is closed-world by design - the one exception to the open-schema rule, so that nothing can ride in under unbanned key names. Runs describe acquisitions; resources describe files, services and data products; nesting never implies one-resource-to-one-run ownership. Frozen only when the freeze gates in AUSMT-STATION-METADATA-SCOPE.md pass.

identifier_row.description: SHARED DEFINITION with ausmt-survey-metadata; DOIs bare-form

source_value.description: the source text, never discarded after normalisation

value.description: present only where parsing is safe; a missing value beats a confidently wrong one

unit_value.description: dual representation for unit-bearing legacy values (contact resistance class)

start.description: ISO 8601 UTC (Z) after source conversion; source timezone provenance retained in curation where conversion was nontrivial

serial_number.description: asserted only where source/adapter semantics establish a physical instance identifier; mt_metadata Instrument.id is not universally a serial

identifiers.description: instrument PIDs; AusMT extension over mt_metadata (which has no PID-capable field); only source-provided, deterministic-registry, or curator-confirmed matches are ever emitted

electrode.description: an Electrode is an Instrument subtype (mt_metadata semantics); PIDs supported, never expected

component.description: e.g. ex, ey, hx, hy, hz

sample_rate_hz.description: override only where a channel genuinely differs from the run's nominal rate; divergence is a curation-review trigger

contact_resistance.description: attaches to the electric measurement circuit, never to the run object; parsed value must be a positive resistance

channel.description: electric channels (component starting e/E, including Phoenix e1/e2) carry positive/negative electrodes and never sensor; magnetic channels (h/H/b/B families) carry sensor and never electrode-circuit fields; guards match by leading letter so case and dialect variants are covered; the emitter normalises component tokens to lowercase

id.description: source run id where one exists; otherwise a PERSISTENT curated local id, assigned once, never regenerated from mutable metadata; unique within the station record

sample_rate_hz.description: nominal run rate; a run is one continuous acquisition at one nominal rate (provisional pending the hardware-change inspection); required whenever any channel declares a rate, so the survey rate rollup can never silently lose rates

run.description: acquisition truth; absent runs[] on a record means run metadata not asserted, never 'no runs occurred'

id.description: stable within this document; relationships never rely on array position or paths

format.description: domain token, e.g. mth5, edi, emtfxml, netcdf, zip

media_type.description: optional, only where certain, e.g. application/x-hdf5

path.description: local served path (manifest/integrity linkage); manifest.json remains the checksum authority

service_urls.description: only services the producer workflow verified valid for this resource's format; no verified_at is published (service health is operational state)

repository.description: controlled token naming the repository that holds this resource (e.g. NCI), its semantics documented with the token; a richer organisation object or reference into survey-metadata.json is deferred until that document exists (no per-resource organisation duplication) - the ratified deferral trigger, verbatim from the scope; survey-metadata.json now exists and is live, so the trigger has FIRED and the deferral is an open owner question, not a standing position. Held as a controlled open string while NCI is the only ratified token, because the schema must serve EarthScope, GA, S3 and institutional repositories identically

related_collection_identifiers.description: identifies a containing product/collection; a collection DOI never masquerades as a file DOI

processing_level.description: clean station vocabulary (schema-lane final), closed on the tokens the scope ratifies (raw plus the level0..level3 class); crosswalked to NCI level names and MTCAT's legacy identifies values - never inherited from them

packaging.description: clean station vocabulary (schema-lane final), closed on the one token the scope ratifies (packed archive); a single served file omits the field, since absence asserts nothing. Widening the enum on a real corpus case is additive and never invalidates an emitted document

access.description: resource-level access state where it differs from the survey's

license.description: omitted = inherits the survey licence (documented inheritance)

represents_runs.description: which runs this resource represents; NOT mutually exclusive with derived_from_runs (a concatenated resampled MTH5 may both represent and derive from runs A/B/C); omitted = mapping not asserted

derived_from_runs.description: which runs fed this derived product; a local convenience, not the whole provenance model

resource.description: an addressable file/service/data representation; granularity = served/addressable things (an archive's internal listing is never expanded here); no numeric science ever appears; a derived resource cannot claim representation_role original (the semantically impossible combination is schema-rejected)

oneOf.title: withheld station record

embargo_until.description: the date the embargo lifts; null where the access state carries no date (the metadata_only case, whose emitted stub writes the key with a null value), so the frozen stub bytes validate as emitted. The null is admitted ONLY where the level carries no date: the conditional below keeps an embargoed record fail-closed on a real date, so a dropped or nulled embargo date on the one live embargoed survey is still rejected

access.description: access state block; closed so nothing can ride inside it

distribution.description: closed legacy block: nothing is distributed for a withheld record

oneOf.description: fail-closed leak protection: the withheld branch is CLOSED-WORLD (additionalProperties false, nested objects closed) - the one deliberate exception to the open-schema rule, because a withheld record's absence semantics are 'deliberately not exposed', and an open object would let coordinates, runs, or instrument identity ride in under unbanned key names. Extending the stub requires a schema change, by design.

oneOf.title: full station record

version.description: version of THIS schema the document conforms to (0.x while draft)

survey_id.description: machine identifier added by the promotion, identical with mtcat's surveys[].survey_id

oneOf.description: the promoted full record: every existing 1.2-era key (location, data, diagnostics, processing, distribution, provenance, coordinate_qc, canonical_conditioning, frame, coordinate_policy, country, organisation) remains permitted and frozen via the open schema; runs[] and resources[] are the new canonical machine surface. The presence rule binds the emitter: no library default is ever serialised as a source assertion.
